title: scenario
$comment: SOURCE p.19 immutable base+patch semantics. D-004, D-012 (APPROVED): an immutable persisted Scenario; no canonical ModelVersion is created by a scenario approval or a manual scenario, and neither queues a run. T-028 (D-021, D-067 APPROVED; D-078, D-079 APPROVED): getScenario, listScenarios and createManualScenario's 201 answer this shape for both kinds of scenario, told apart by source_proposal_id; patch is the stored patch in RFC 8785 form and patch_hash its D-019 hash.

source_proposal_id.description: The approved scenario proposal whose one effect this scenario is (T-026; its Approval's scenario_id), or null for a scenario a person saved with createManualScenario (T-028).
